question: What is the name of the bridge whose foundation stone was laid by West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee to connect Sagar Island?
solution: The correct answer is __**Gangasagar Setu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee laid the foundation stone for the Gangasagar Setu.
